title: Relationship Between Polymorphism of Heat Shock Protein 70 Gene and Hepatocellular Carcinoma
brief_summary: Polymorphisms of HSP70 and tumor necrosis factor-alpha promoter in patients with hepatocellular carcinoma, chronic liver disease and healthy controls will be measured by PCR-RFLP or direct sequencing. The clinical relevance of patients will be compared in those with polymorphism and those without.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* History proven HCC patients

Exclusion Criteria:

* No-definite diagnosed patients
